applies_why: The judge text makes UNDERDETERMINED turn on the cited verse not naming whose body is the channel, which is a single verse's non-statement.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: The phrase 'without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open' could mean (1) the verse's silence makes the issue UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids, or (2) after weighing the parties' competing chains the overall support is balanced, which K-S2 permits; the judge's wording ties the open point to the verse's not naming the channel, so I read it as (1).
why: The judge grounds UNDERDETERMINED on Acts 2:30 not naming whose body is the channel, exactly the kind of single-verse non-statement K-S2 forbids as a basis for UNDERDETERMINED.
